title: Bump postal-mime to a patched version once it is at least two weeks old (4.0.8 or later, eligible after 2026-10-31)
description: postal-mime 4.0.5 carries advisory GHSA-f2hq-32vh-53cc (high: quadratic CPU on many RFC 2047 base64 encoded words in one header), fixed in 4.0.8. A bump is held back by the two-week age rule; 4.0.8 became eligible after 2026-10-31. Until then PR 644 mitigates with explicit parser limits (maxHeadersSize 131072, maxNestingDepth 16, maxPartCount 200) and a Gherkin scenario in features/email_inbound_parsing.feature that a header with 40000 encoded words is refused fast and counted. On the bump: pin the exact version, re-run the email features, and decide whether the explicit limits stay (they should).
